newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern extends Conrail offer.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern extends Conrail offer.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said on Thursday that it was extending its $110 per share cash tender offer for all the shares of Conrail Inc through midnight EDT on December 16, 1996.
The offer was originally set to expire on midnight EDT on November 22, Norfolk Southern said.
Norfolk Southern, which launched a rival bid to Conrail's planned $8.5 billion merger with CSX Corp, said earlier it would also continue to pursue its legal case seeking to block the planned merger.
The company said that as of November 21 afternoon, about 1.4 million Conrail shares had been tendered and not withdrawn pursuant to Norfolk Southern's offer.
